This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52

              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │

                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

154	### 4.2 validate：冲突矩阵
155	
156	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
157	
158	`validate` 是 ModelLine 的第五个方法（有默认实现的那个「空通过」），Qwen3Line 把它写成了一个大矩阵。它解决的问题是：**有些 flag 组合在语法上完全合法、每个值也合法，但组合起来语义不成立**。例如 `--batch-invariant` 与 `--tp-size 2`：单卡数值不变式的前提在张量并行下根本不存在。
159	
160	这类规则不能放进 clap 的 `requires`/`conflicts`（那是「存在性依赖」，u2-l2 讲过判据），因为它们要交叉读**值**（`tp_size` 的数值、`decode_overlap` 的档位）与**出身**（`provided` 集合）。所以 trait 文档把它定位为「`arg_requirements` 之外的跨 flag 规则，在注册表的 consume-or-reject 之后运行」（[../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:363-371](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L363-L371)）。
161	
162	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
163	
164	`validate` 在 server 主流程中的位置（u1-l3 讲过整条链，这里只看本讲相关的三行）：
165	
166	```text
167	registry.detect(&config)            // 检测门（u1-l4）
168	registry.validate_provided(...)     // 归属门：consume-or-reject（u2-l3）
169	shared.validate(&provided)          // 语义门（共享面，u2-l2）
170	line.validate(&ctx, &provided)      // ◄── 本讲：线内冲突矩阵
171	line.serve_plan(&ctx)               // 服务计划（u2-l5）
172	spawn_blocking { line.launch(ctx) } // 引擎加载（4.3）
173	```
174	
175	对应 [src/main.rs:177-186](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L177-L186)。关键时序事实：`info!("=== pegainfer - {} (GPU) ===")` 与 `info!("Loading engine...")` 在 validate **之后**才打印（[src/main.rs:188-189](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L188-L189)），所以「日志里有没有出现 Loading engine」就是「错误发生在校验期还是加载期」的可观察分界线。
176	
177	矩阵的判定输入有三个：
178	
179	1. `cli(ctx)` 取回的独占值（布尔、Option）；
180	2. `ctx.shared` 的共享值（数值、档位）；
181	3. `provided` 出身集合——只在 LoRA 参数组用到一次（`max_loras` / `max_lora_rank` 有默认值，不能比值，只能问「用户是否显式给过」）。
182	
183	违反任何一条立即返回 `CliError::rule("...")`——`CliError::Rule(String)` 的文档说「规则是散文，不是分类学」，消息本身就是面向用户的解释（[../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:51-66](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L51-L66)）。

185	#### 4.2.3 源码精读
186	
187	`validate` 全体是一个顺序 if 链（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:181-286](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L181-L286)），按「触发前提」分成五段：
188	
189	**第一段：LoRA 参数组的门槛**（[L188-L202](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L188-L202)）。
190	
191	```rust
192	if !cli.enable_lora && !cli.lora_modules.is_empty() {
193	    return Err(CliError::rule("--lora-modules requires --enable-lora"));
194	}
195	if !cli.enable_lora
196	    && (provided.contains("max_loras") || provided.contains("max_lora_rank"))
197	{
198	    return Err(CliError::rule(
199	        "--max-loras and --max-lora-rank require --enable-lora",
200	    ));
201	}
202	```
203	
204	注意第二条是 `provided` 出身语义的教科书案例：`max_loras` 永远有默认值 `1`，比「值是否等于默认」既不可靠也不诚实，只有「用户显式写过它」才构成「用户想配置 LoRA」的证据。第三条规则方向相反——是共享 flag 拒绝独占 flag：`--dump-graph-png` 与 `--enable-lora` 互斥，消息顺带解释了原因（LoRA 禁用 CUDA Graph）。

206	**第二段：decode-overlap 的单卡限制**（[L203-L207](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L203-L207)）：`decode_overlap != Off && tp_size > 1` 即拒。注意它读的是共享 flag 的**值**（档位与数值的交叉），这正是它不能进 clap 依赖表的原因。
207	
208	**第三段：`--batch-invariant` 冲突表**（外层条件 `cli.batch_invariant`，[L208-L242](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L208-L242)）。抄成二维表：
209	
210	| # | 冲突对象（判定条件） | 错误消息（节选） | 消息里的「为什么」 |
211	|---|---|---|---|
212	| 1 | `--enable-lora`（`cli.enable_lora`） | `--batch-invariant is not supported with --enable-lora; enable one at a time` | 二者一次只能开一个 |
213	| 2 | `--decode-overlap` ≠ off | `not compatible with --decode-overlap; the stream override would force the pinned GEMM to bail at runtime` | 流覆盖会迫使钉住的 GEMM 在运行时退坑 |
214	| 3 | `--kv-offload` | `not supported with --kv-offload: offload keeps prefix matching on ... and a host-tier prefix hit shifts a prompt's chunk boundaries off the request-local grid` | 主机 tier 的前缀命中会把分块边界挪离请求自身网格 |
215	| 4 | `--dflash-draft-model-path` | `not supported with DFlash speculative decoding; enable one at a time` | 二选一 |
216	| 5 | `--tp-size > 1` | `not supported with --tp-size > 1; enable one at a time` | 单卡特性 |
217	| 6 | **缺** `--no-prefix-cache`（`!shared.no_prefix_cache`） | `--batch-invariant requires --no-prefix-cache; prefix-cache hits move a prompt's chunk boundaries off the request-local grid` | 前缀缓存命中同样会挪动分块边界 |
218	
219	第 6 条是**正向要求**（不是互斥）：batch-invariant 的前提是每个 prompt 的 prefill 在自己的网格上分块，而任何前缀命中都会跳过一段前缀、把边界挪走——所以规则 3 与 6 的「为什么」其实是同一个物理原因的两种表现。
220	
221	**第四段：`--dflash-draft-model-path` 冲突表**（外层条件 `shared.dflash_draft_model_path.is_some()`，[L243-L259](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L243-L259)）：互斥 `--enable-lora`、`--kv-offload`，要求 `--tp-size=1`。注意 DFlash 是**共享 flag**（`SharedArgs.dflash_draft_model_path`，GLM5.2 也用它接 DSpark drafter，见 [../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:198-204](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L198-L204)），而 EAGLE-3 是 Qwen3 独占——同名物在两层体系里各有一个，这是个容易混淆的点。
222	
223	**第五段：`--eagle3-draft-model-path` 冲突表**——写法换成了「谓词表 + find」（[L260-L284](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L260-L284)）：

225	```rust
226	let conflicts = [
227	    (shared.dflash_draft_model_path.is_some(), "--dflash-draft-model-path"),
228	    (cli.enable_lora, "--enable-lora"),
229	    (shared.kv_offload, "--kv-offload"),
230	    (shared.decode_overlap != CliDecodeOverlap::Off, "--decode-overlap"),
231	    (cli.batch_invariant, "--batch-invariant"),
232	];
233	if let Some((_, flag)) = conflicts.iter().find(|(set, _)| *set) {
234	    return Err(CliError::rule(format!(
235	        "--eagle3-draft-model-path is not supported with {flag}"
236	    )));
237	}
238	if shared.tp_size != 1 {
239	    return Err(CliError::rule(
240	        "--eagle3-draft-model-path currently requires --tp-size=1",
241	    ));
242	}
243	```
244	
245	抄成二维表：
246	
247	| # | 冲突对象（判定条件） | 错误消息 |
248	|---|---|---|
249	| 1 | `--dflash-draft-model-path` 已提供 | `--eagle3-draft-model-path is not supported with --dflash-draft-model-path` |
250	| 2 | `--enable-lora` | `... is not supported with --enable-lora` |
251	| 3 | `--kv-offload` | `... is not supported with --kv-offload` |
252	| 4 | `--decode-overlap` ≠ off | `... is not supported with --decode-overlap` |

256	两段风格对比是有意的教学素材：if 链每条可以有定制的长解释（batch-invariant 的第 2、3、6 条都带物理原因），表 + find 则把同构规则压成数据、按声明顺序取**第一个**命中——所以同时给 `--enable-lora --kv-offload` 时，报的是表里靠前的 `--enable-lora`。

258	另一个值得注意的不对称：字段文档说 EAGLE-3 「forces the prefix cache off」（引擎侧行为，launch 自己关），而 `--batch-invariant` 要求**用户亲手**传 `--no-prefix-cache`（校验期拒绝）。同样是与前缀缓存不相容，一个是引擎代劳、一个是硬性 CLI 前提。

287	### 4.3 launch：把两面 CLI 折成 Qwen3LaunchOptions
288	
289	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
290	
291	`launch` 是 trait 的最后一个方法，也是唯一必选的「重」方法：加载引擎、启动调度器线程、把句柄交还 server。但本讲聚焦它的**前半段**——选项组装：把 `SharedArgs`（15 个消费字段的值）与 `Qwen3Cli`（13 个独占字段）折叠成 crate 内部的单一结构 `Qwen3LaunchOptions`，再调用 `crate::launch`。
292	
293	这个折叠有一句设计宣言，写在 `Qwen3LaunchOptions` 的文档注释里：二进制把原始 CLI flag 映射进这个结构；**启动策略（TP→设备映射、LoRA↔CUDA-Graph 互斥等）归 `launch` 所有，跟模型住在一起，不漏进 server**（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs:224-229](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs#L224-L229)）。也就是说：CLI 层的 `validate` 负责「用户可知的规则」，引擎层的 `crate::launch` 负责「实现可知的策略」——例如 LoRA 会强制关掉 CUDA Graph 并打一条 warn，这发生在 launch 内部而非 validate（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs:275-284](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs#L275-L284)）。
294	
295	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
296	
297	`ModelLine::launch`（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:296-367](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L296-L367)）的折叠伪代码：
298	
299	```text
300	launch(ctx):
301	    cli    = Qwen3Cli::from_arg_matches(ctx.matches)   # 取回独占值
302	    shared = ctx.shared                                  # 只读共享值
303	
304	    # 1) offload：三段嵌套组装
305	    offload = if shared.kv_offload:
306	        bytes = kv_offload_host_gib 换算成字节
307	        o = Qwen3OffloadOptions::enabled(bytes)
308	        o.use_hugepages = kv_offload_hugepages
309	        if (metaserver_addr, advertise_addr) 都给了:
310	            o = o.with_p2p(地址 + nics + cli.kv_p2p_flush_on_finish)
311	        if cli.kv_pd_vllm_seed 给了:
312	            o = o.with_vllm_compat(seed + namespace.expect(...) + miss_wait)
313	        o
314	    else:
315	        Qwen3OffloadOptions::disabled()
316	
317	    # 2) lora：enable_lora 才有内容
318	    lora = cli.enable_lora ? Qwen3LoraOptions{max_loras, max_lora_rank} : None
319	
320	    # 3) 显存：MiB→字节防溢出，再就地校验取值
321	    margin_bytes = kv_cache_memory_margin_mib.checked_mul(1<<20) 否则 anyhow 报错
322	    memory = Qwen3MemoryOptions::new(util, margin_bytes, page).validate()?
323	
324	    # 4) 一把折成 Qwen3LaunchOptions，调用 crate::launch
325	    crate::launch(ctx.model_path, Qwen3LaunchOptions{...})    # 返回 Engine
326	        .map(LaunchedEngine::Stepped)                          # 包成交接类型
327	```
328	
329	`crate::launch` 内部再按策略分派：有 LoRA 走 `start_engine_with_lora_control`（铸造控制平面），否则走 `start_engine_with_offload_inner` 并带上 drafter 与图导出路径（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs:337-367](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs#L337-L367)）。

331	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
332	
333	**offload 的三段嵌套**（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:299-327](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L299-L327)）：GiB→字节换算、开 `Qwen3OffloadOptions::enabled`、贴上 hugepages 开关；两个 P2P 地址**同时**给了才 `with_p2p`（这两个的同时性由 `SHARED_ARG_REQUIREMENTS` 的 `kv_p2p_metaserver_addr → {kv_offload, kv_p2p_advertise_addr, kv_p2p_nics}` 依赖边保证，见 [../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:223-232](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L223-L232)）；`kv_pd_vllm_seed` 给了才 `with_vllm_compat`。
334	
335	其中这句最值得停下来看：
336	
337	```rust
338	namespace: cli
339	    .kv_pd_vllm_namespace
340	    .clone()
341	    .expect("clap requires kv_pd_vllm_namespace"),
342	```
343	
344	一个 `expect` 敢写在这里，是因为它的安全性由**两台前置机器**共同保证：`arg_requirements` 声明了 `kv_pd_vllm_seed → kv_pd_vllm_namespace` 的依赖边（clap 解析期执行），而 u2-l3 讲过注册表在**构造期**校验过这条边的目标 id 真实存在。缺任何一台，这行都是隐患；两台都在，它是把「跨模块不变量」压缩成一行的惯用法。
345	
346	**lora 与显存预算**（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:328-340](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L328-L340)）：`enable_lora.then_some(...)` 把布尔翻成 `Option`；`checked_mul(1 << 20)` 防 MiB→字节换算溢出，溢出时返回 anyhow 错误（这是「深上下文、调用方不分支」错误哲学的又一次体现——u2-l1 讲过 launch 的错误用 anyhow 的原因）。
347	
348	`Qwen3MemoryOptions::validate()` 只查两件事：`0 < gpu_memory_utilization <= 1`，且页大小在 `{16, 64}` 内（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs:65-78](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L65-L78)）。注意这两条**没有**对应的 clap 取值解析器——它们住在模型 crate 里，失败的时机在 launch 内部（`spawn_blocking` 线程上），错误链会带上外层 `.with_context(|| format!("failed to start {} engine", line.name()))` 的前缀（[src/main.rs:204-213](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L204-L213)）。同一段里 `max_prefill_tokens` 缺省时落到 crate 默认 `DEFAULT_MAX_PREFILL_TOKENS = 1024`（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/scheduler.rs:416](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/scheduler.rs#L416)）。
349	
350	**枚举翻译**：CLI 侧的 `CliDecodeOverlap`（frontend，三档：`off`/`stream`/`green-ctx`）经 `resolve_decode_overlap` 翻成引擎侧的 `DecodeOverlap`，green-ctx 档顺带把共享 flag `decode_sm_pct` 塞进变体载荷（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:118-126](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L118-L126)；引擎枚举见 [../pegainfer-qwen3/src/green_ctx.rs:29-38](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/green_ctx.rs#L29-L38)）。两个同名枚举分居两侧，正是「接缝上只传值、不传类型」的体现。
351	
352	**最后的交接**：`crate::launch(...).map(LaunchedEngine::Stepped)`（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:341-366](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L341-L366)）。Qwen3 已完成向新一代 step 驱动契约的迁移，返回 `Engine`（实现了 `Scheduler`）后包成 `LaunchedEngine::Stepped`——这就是 u1-l3 说过的「LoRA 分支要求 `Stepped`」能对 Qwen3 成立的原因。顺带一提 `serve_plan`（u2-l5 的主角，此处一笔带过）：Qwen3Line 只设 `lora_modules` 一个字段，其余全走 `ServePlan::default()`（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:288-294](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L288-L294)）。
353	
354	**`crate::launch` 持有的策略**（我们只看与 CLI 相关的几条）：TP→设备映射（单卡用 `device_ordinal`，多卡占 `0..tp_size`，[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs:270-274](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs#L270-L274)）；LoRA 强制关 CUDA Graph 并 warn（[L275-L284](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs#L275-L284)）；图导出的前置检查（[L285-L295](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs#L285-L295)）；DFlash 与 EAGLE-3 不能同载、drafter 不与 LoRA / decode-overlap 组合（[L316-L336](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs#L316-L336)）。这些 `ensure!` 与 CLI `validate` 部分重叠——重叠不是浪费，是「CLI 层早失败省时间、引擎层承重保安全」的分层（见 4.2.3 末尾）。

413	- 用**完整真实 config** 时，预期推进得更远——到分词器或权重分片读取（目录里没有这些文件）。
414	
415	**第四步：下结论**。把两次运行的「最后一条日志 + 错误首行」填进下表：
416	
417	| 运行 | 最后日志 | 错误首行（示意） | 失败阶段 |
418	|---|---|---|---|
419	| A | （无横幅） | `--batch-invariant requires --no-prefix-cache...` | CLI validate |
420	| B | `Loading engine...` | 待本地验证 | 引擎加载（config 解析 / 文件读取） |
421	
422	这就用可观察证据坐实了本讲的核心论断：`validate` 的全部规则都在 `launch` 之前，错误会随 flag 补全而沿装配线前进。本讲义写作环境无 GPU、未执行构建，第二、三步的具体输出**待本地验证**——但「A 无横幅即拒」这一点由 [src/main.rs:185-189](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L185-L189) 的语句顺序直接保证。
423	
424	## 6. 本讲小结
425	
426	- **独占 CLI 面**：`Qwen3Cli` 五组十三个 flag（LoRA 4、KV P2P/PD 4、显存预算 3、batch-invariant 1、EAGLE-3 1），类型私有、拼写公开；三个取值解析器把格式错误挡在 clap 解析期——早于读取 `config.json`。
427	- **两份声明**：`consumed_shared_args`（15 个共享 id）划定消费面，`arg_requirements`（4 条边）把存在性依赖交给 clap；后者与注册表构造期校验一起，让 launch 里的 `.expect` 成为安全不变量。
428	- **冲突矩阵**：`validate` 以「provided 出身 + 两面 CLI 当前值」交叉判定，五段规则覆盖 LoRA 门槛、overlap 单卡限制、batch-invariant（6 条）、DFlash（3+1 条）、EAGLE-3（5+1 条）；两种写法（if 链 vs 谓词表 + find）各有取舍，消息即 API。
429	- **分层失败**：同一规则可出现在 CLI validate（最便宜）→ `crate::launch` 的 `ensure!`（权重加载前）→ 引擎承重守卫（最深）三层；可观察分界线是 `Loading engine...` 横幅。
430	- **launch 折叠**：`SharedArgs + Qwen3Cli → Qwen3LaunchOptions → crate::launch → LaunchedEngine::Stepped`；启动策略（TP 设备映射、LoRA 关图、drafter 互斥）归模型 crate 所有，不漏进 server。
431	- Qwen3 是 trait 的「八方法满配」参照实现（u2-l1 的结论在此落地），且其冲突矩阵中 batch-invariant 一支尚无专门单测——那是读者可贡献的第一块砖。
432	
433	## 7. 下一步学习建议
434	
435	- **u2-l5（ServePlan）**：本讲两次路过 `serve_plan` 都一笔带过——下一讲专门讲「引擎加载前前端就必须知道的事实」如何经 `ServePlan` 流出，以及 main.rs 如何按它选 serve 分支。
436	- **延伸阅读源码**：`../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs` 的 `crate::launch` 全体（L269-L368）与 `start_engine_with_lora_control` / `start_engine_with_offload_inner` 两个分派终点，看 CLI 选项如何变成引擎线程。
437	- **对照另一条线**：快速浏览 `../pegainfer-frontend/examples/echo-server.rs` 的 `EchoLine`（三方法最小实现），体会「满配」与「最小」之间的谱系——这也是 u5-l2（从零接入一条新模型线）的预习。
438	- **单元三预告**：launch 交回的 `LaunchedEngine::Stepped` 里装的是什么？u3-l1 起进入引擎契约：两代契约并存的地图、`Scheduler` trait 与 `drive` 轮询循环。

# 一条真实模型线：Qwen3Line 的独占 CLI 与校验矩阵

> 前置讲义：u2-l1（ModelLine trait 的接缝）、u2-l2（SharedArgs 三层 flag 体系）、u2-l3（注册表自检）。
> 本讲把前几讲的抽象骨架落到一条真实的、默认编译进二进制的模型线上。

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 分组列出 Qwen3Line 的全部独占 CLI flag：LoRA（`--enable-lora` / `--lora-modules` / `--max-loras` / `--max-lora-rank`）、KV P2P/PD（`--kv-p2p-flush-on-finish` / `--kv-pd-vllm-seed` / `--kv-pd-vllm-namespace` / `--kv-pd-miss-wait-ms`）、显存预算（`--gpu-memory-utilization` / `--kv-cache-memory-margin-mib` / `--kv-page-size`）、`--batch-invariant`、`--eagle3-draft-model-path`。
2. 读懂 `validate()` 冲突矩阵的写法：它以「`provided` 出身集合 + 两面 CLI 的当前值」交叉判断，违反即返回 `CliError::rule`，且全部发生在引擎加载之前。
3. 跟踪 `launch()` 如何把 `SharedArgs` 与 `Qwen3Cli` 折叠成一个 `Qwen3LaunchOptions`，交给 crate 内部的 `crate::launch`，最后包成 `LaunchedEngine::Stepped` 交还 server。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲默认你已从 u2-l1～u2-l3 建立了以下认知，这里只做一句话回顾：

- **ModelLine trait**：模型线暴露给 server 的全部表面，8 个方法里 `name` / `probe` / `launch` 必选，其余五个有默认实现（u2-l1）。
- **三层 flag 体系**：核心 flag（`CORE_ARGS`，全线放行）、共享 flag（`SharedArgs` 定义，消费权由 `consumed_shared_args` 声明）、线独占 flag（`augment_cli` 挂上）（u2-l2）。
- **provided 出身语义**：`provided_args` 借 clap 的 `ValueSource` 记录「用户显式提供过哪些 flag」，与默认值无关——因为默认值永远存在，只能问出身，不能比值（u2-l2）。
- **注册表自检**：`ModelLineRegistry::new` 在构造期对 flag id 与拼写查唯一性，并校验 `arg_requirements` 引用的目标 id 真实存在（u2-l3）。

再补几个本讲会遇到的领域术语（初学者向）：

| 术语 | 通俗解释 |
|---|---|
| LoRA | Low-Rank Adaptation：挂在基座模型上的小权重「补丁」（适配器），运行时可在线切换，比整模型小几个数量级。服务 LoRA 意味着每步可能重指向不同适配器。 |
| P/D 分离 | Prefill/Decode 分离部署：处理 prompt 的 prefill 实例与逐 token 生成的 decode 实例分开部署，中间靠转移 KV（键值缓存）衔接。 |
| KV P2P | 跨实例的 KV 点对点共享：块哈希注册到 MetaServer，缺失前缀经 RDMA 从同伴实例拉回。 |
| 投机解码 | Drafter（小草稿模型）先猜若干 token，Target（大模型）一次验证，命中即省多步前向。Qwen3 支持 DFlash 与 EAGLE-3 两种 drafter。 |
| batch-invariant | 数值路径与 batch 组成无关：同一条 prompt 无论和谁同批，输出逐位相同。要求每个 prompt 的 prefill 分块走自己的网格。 |
| PYTHONHASHSEED | vLLM 前缀缓存哈希依赖的 Python 随机化种子；P/D 两侧必须共享同一值才能对上哈希。 |

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 角色 |
|---|---|
| `../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs` | **本讲主角**。`Qwen3Line` 的全部实现：`Qwen3Cli` 独占 flag、`validate` 冲突矩阵、`launch` 选项组装，以及一组无 GPU 即可运行的单元测试。 |
| `../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs` | 契约侧。`ModelLine` trait、`SharedArgs`、`LaunchContext`、`CliError`、`ArgRequirement`、`CliDecodeOverlap` 的定义。 |
| `../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs` | `Qwen3LaunchOptions` 定义与 `crate::launch`：真正持有 Qwen3 启动策略的地方。 |
| `../pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs` | `Qwen3MemoryOptions`（显存预算三参数）及其 `validate()`。 |
| `../pegainfer-qwen3/src/green_ctx.rs` | crate 内部 `DecodeOverlap` 枚举（CLI 枚举的引擎侧对应物）。 |
| `../pegainfer-qwen3/src/config.rs` | `probe_config_json`：probe 的第二级身份检查。 |
| `../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/lora.rs` | `parse_lora_modules_arg`：`--lora-modules` 的取值解析器。 |
| `src/main.rs` | server 侧调用点：校验链的顺序与 `spawn_blocking` 加载引擎。 |

永久链接均指向当前 HEAD（`af9e40e1`），路径相对 `pegainfer-server/` 书写。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 Qwen3Cli：Qwen3 独占的 CLI 面

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

u2-l2 讲过：共享 flag「定义一次、消费权按线声明」。但每条模型线总有只属于自己的旋钮——Qwen3 的 LoRA 服务、KV P2P/PD 角色、显存预算、数值不变式、EAGLE-3 投机解码，别的线没有这些概念。这些 flag 定义在 qwen3 crate 私有的 `Qwen3Cli` 结构体里，server 二进制**看不见它的类型**，只能在 `--help` 里看见它的拼写。这就是「独占」的含义：类型知识不越过接缝，拼写知识对用户公开。

除了独占 flag，本模块还一并看 Qwen3Line 对外的两份「CLI 声明」：

- `consumed_shared_args`：声明这条线读哪些共享 flag——15 个，是共享面上绝大多数；
- `arg_requirements`：声明独占 flag 的无条件依赖边，交给注册表在 clap 解析期执行。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

从 flag 定义到 server 命令行的装配过程：

1. server 构造命令时，`Qwen3Line::augment_cli` 把 `Qwen3Cli` 的字段并入 clap 命令（`Qwen3Cli::augment_args`，clap derive 的机制）。
2. clap 解析合并后的命令：独占 flag 的 `value_parser`（如 `parse_max_lora_rank_arg`）与 `arg_requirements` 声明的依赖都在**这一步**执行——早于读取 `config.json`，更早于引擎加载。
3. 检测命中 Qwen3 后，`validate` / `serve_plan` / `launch` 需要读回独占值时，经帮手函数 `cli(ctx)` 用 `Qwen3Cli::from_arg_matches(ctx.matches)` 从合并命令的完整解析结果里取回——因为命令已被同一套定义解析过，这里只可能因注册表 bug 而 panic，不会因用户输入失败。

```text
augment_cli(Qwen3Cli 字段) ──► 合并命令 ──► clap 解析（值门 + 依赖门）
                                          │
                                          ▼
                        cli(ctx) = Qwen3Cli::from_arg_matches(matches)
                        （validate / serve_plan / launch 各自调用，取得类型化的独占值）
```

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

模块文档一句话点明本文件的全貌：config 探测、Qwen3 独占 CLI 段、跨 flag 规则、launch 选项组装，server 只见到 `&MODEL_LINE`（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:1-3](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L1-L3)）。

**独占 flag 全表**。`Qwen3Cli` 是一个 clap derive 结构体（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:35-116](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L35-L116)），按功能分五组：

| 分组 | flag | 类型 / 默认 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|---|
| LoRA | `--enable-lora` | `bool`，`false` | 开启 Qwen3 LoRA 服务模式（[L38-L40](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L38-L40)） |
| LoRA | `--lora-modules` | `Vec<LoraModule>`，可重复 | 启动时装载的适配器；接受 `name=path`、JSON 对象或单元素 JSON 列表（[L42-L45](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L42-L45)） |
| LoRA | `--max-loras` | `usize`，默认 `1`（`Qwen3LoraOptions::DEFAULT_MAX_LORAS`） | 常驻适配器数量上限（[L47-L49](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L47-L49)） |
| LoRA | `--max-lora-rank` | `usize`，默认 `64`；只接受 `{1,8,16,32,64,128,256,320,512}` | 支持的最大 LoRA rank（[L51-L53](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L51-L53)；取值集合见 [../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs:52-54](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs#L52-L54)） |
| KV P2P/PD | `--kv-p2p-flush-on-finish` | `bool`，`false` | P/D **prefill 角色**：请求终局前屏障 KV 落盘与注册，让 HTTP 响应本身成为「KV 就绪」信号（[L55-L60](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L55-L60)） |
| KV P2P/PD | `--kv-pd-vllm-seed` | `Option<String>`，PYTHONHASHSEED 格式 | P/D **decode 角色**：与 vLLM prefill 对端共享的哈希种子（[L62-L69](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L62-L69)） |
| KV P2P/PD | `--kv-pd-vllm-namespace` | `Option<String>`，8 位小写 hex | pegaflow connector 命名空间摘要（[L71-L77](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L71-L77)） |
| KV P2P/PD | `--kv-pd-miss-wait-ms` | `u64`，默认 `5000` | 零命中等待窗口，须低于执行器 15s 远程取数期限（[L79-L84](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L79-L84)） |
| 显存预算 | `--gpu-memory-utilization` | `f64`，默认 `0.90` | 总显存预算比例，KV 池吃掉刨去权重与运行时后的剩余（[L86-L91](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L86-L91)） |
| 显存预算 | `--kv-cache-memory-margin-mib` | `usize`，默认 `150` MiB | 尺寸化之后再留出的碎片余量（[L93-L96](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L93-L96)） |
| 显存预算 | `--kv-page-size` | `usize`，默认 `16`（或 `64`） | KV 页（块）大小，受 FlashInfer 内核约束（[L98-L102](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L98-L102)） |
| 数值不变式 | `--batch-invariant` | `bool`，`false` | 单卡批量不变式服务；要求 `--no-prefix-cache`（[L104-L108](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L104-L108)） |
| 投机解码 | `--eagle3-draft-model-path` | `Option<PathBuf>` | EAGLE-3 drafter 模型路径；贪婪请求独占活跃时起草（[L110-L115](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L110-L115)） |

注意 struct 上方那条**普通注释**（非 doc 注释）：作者特意说明「doc 注释会经 clap 的 augment 覆盖命令的 about」，所以结构级说明用 `//` 而字段的 `///` 进 `--help`（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:32-34](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L32-L34)）。`SharedArgs` 上有同款注释（u2-l2 已见）。

**三个取值解析器**把「格式错误」挡在 clap 解析期（比 u2-l2 的「值门」还要早——连 `config.json` 都还没读）：

- `parse_max_lora_rank_arg`：数值必须落在支持集合内，否则报出全部合法值（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:370-382](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L370-L382)）；
- `parse_pythonhashseed`：必须是 `[0, 4294967295]` 的十进制整数且**不允许 `+` 前缀**——注释说明了动机：一个格式良好但与对端不相等的种子会派生出永远匹配不上的 key 空间，这类配置错误必须在启动期失败，而不是变成「每个请求都慢」（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:384-394](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L384-L394)）；
- `parse_pegaflow_namespace`：恰好 8 个小写 hex 字符（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:396-408](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L396-L408)）。

`--lora-modules` 的解析器在 frontend 侧：`parse_lora_modules_arg` 接受 `name=path`、JSON 对象或恰好一个元素的 JSON 列表，多元素列表会被拒绝并提示改用多次 `--lora-modules`（[../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/lora.rs:73-96](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/vllm/lora.rs#L73-L96)）。

**两份 CLI 声明**。`consumed_shared_args` 列出 Qwen3 消费的 15 个共享 flag id——从 `cuda_graph` 到 `decode_sm_pct`，几乎整个共享面（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:149-167](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L149-L167)）。没被消费的共享 flag（如 `dp_size`）若被显式提供，会在 `validate_provided` 的 consume-or-reject 里以 `--dp-size is not used by Qwen3` 拒绝——本文件的单测 `rejects_other_lines_flags` 逐字断言了这条消息（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:503-510](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L503-L510)）。

`arg_requirements` 声明四条无条件依赖边（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:169-179](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L169-L179)）：


### 4.2 validate：冲突矩阵

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`validate` 是 ModelLine 的第五个方法（有默认实现的那个「空通过」），Qwen3Line 把它写成了一个大矩阵。它解决的问题是：**有些 flag 组合在语法上完全合法、每个值也合法，但组合起来语义不成立**。例如 `--batch-invariant` 与 `--tp-size 2`：单卡数值不变式的前提在张量并行下根本不存在。

这类规则不能放进 clap 的 `requires`/`conflicts`（那是「存在性依赖」，u2-l2 讲过判据），因为它们要交叉读**值**（`tp_size` 的数值、`decode_overlap` 的档位）与**出身**（`provided` 集合）。所以 trait 文档把它定位为「`arg_requirements` 之外的跨 flag 规则，在注册表的 consume-or-reject 之后运行」（[../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:363-371](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L363-L371)）。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

`validate` 在 server 主流程中的位置（u1-l3 讲过整条链，这里只看本讲相关的三行）：

```text
registry.detect(&config)            // 检测门（u1-l4）
registry.validate_provided(...)     // 归属门：consume-or-reject（u2-l3）
shared.validate(&provided)          // 语义门（共享面，u2-l2）
line.validate(&ctx, &provided)      // ◄── 本讲：线内冲突矩阵
line.serve_plan(&ctx)               // 服务计划（u2-l5）
spawn_blocking { line.launch(ctx) } // 引擎加载（4.3）
```

对应 [src/main.rs:177-186](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L177-L186)。关键时序事实：`info!("=== pegainfer - {} (GPU) ===")` 与 `info!("Loading engine...")` 在 validate **之后**才打印（[src/main.rs:188-189](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L188-L189)），所以「日志里有没有出现 Loading engine」就是「错误发生在校验期还是加载期」的可观察分界线。

矩阵的判定输入有三个：

1. `cli(ctx)` 取回的独占值（布尔、Option）；
2. `ctx.shared` 的共享值（数值、档位）；
3. `provided` 出身集合——只在 LoRA 参数组用到一次（`max_loras` / `max_lora_rank` 有默认值，不能比值，只能问「用户是否显式给过」）。

违反任何一条立即返回 `CliError::rule("...")`——`CliError::Rule(String)` 的文档说「规则是散文，不是分类学」，消息本身就是面向用户的解释（[../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:51-66](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L51-L66)）。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

`validate` 全体是一个顺序 if 链（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:181-286](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L181-L286)），按「触发前提」分成五段：

**第一段：LoRA 参数组的门槛**（[L188-L202](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L188-L202)）。

```rust
if !cli.enable_lora && !cli.lora_modules.is_empty() {
    return Err(CliError::rule("--lora-modules requires --enable-lora"));
}
if !cli.enable_lora
    && (provided.contains("max_loras") || provided.contains("max_lora_rank"))
{
    return Err(CliError::rule(
        "--max-loras and --max-lora-rank require --enable-lora",
    ));
}
```

注意第二条是 `provided` 出身语义的教科书案例：`max_loras` 永远有默认值 `1`，比「值是否等于默认」既不可靠也不诚实，只有「用户显式写过它」才构成「用户想配置 LoRA」的证据。第三条规则方向相反——是共享 flag 拒绝独占 flag：`--dump-graph-png` 与 `--enable-lora` 互斥，消息顺带解释了原因（LoRA 禁用 CUDA Graph）。

**第二段：decode-overlap 的单卡限制**（[L203-L207](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L203-L207)）：`decode_overlap != Off && tp_size > 1` 即拒。注意它读的是共享 flag 的**值**（档位与数值的交叉），这正是它不能进 clap 依赖表的原因。

**第三段：`--batch-invariant` 冲突表**（外层条件 `cli.batch_invariant`，[L208-L242](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L208-L242)）。抄成二维表：

| # | 冲突对象（判定条件） | 错误消息（节选） | 消息里的「为什么」 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `--enable-lora`（`cli.enable_lora`） | `--batch-invariant is not supported with --enable-lora; enable one at a time` | 二者一次只能开一个 |
| 2 | `--decode-overlap` ≠ off | `not compatible with --decode-overlap; the stream override would force the pinned GEMM to bail at runtime` | 流覆盖会迫使钉住的 GEMM 在运行时退坑 |
| 3 | `--kv-offload` | `not supported with --kv-offload: offload keeps prefix matching on ... and a host-tier prefix hit shifts a prompt's chunk boundaries off the request-local grid` | 主机 tier 的前缀命中会把分块边界挪离请求自身网格 |
| 4 | `--dflash-draft-model-path` | `not supported with DFlash speculative decoding; enable one at a time` | 二选一 |
| 5 | `--tp-size > 1` | `not supported with --tp-size > 1; enable one at a time` | 单卡特性 |
| 6 | **缺** `--no-prefix-cache`（`!shared.no_prefix_cache`） | `--batch-invariant requires --no-prefix-cache; prefix-cache hits move a prompt's chunk boundaries off the request-local grid` | 前缀缓存命中同样会挪动分块边界 |

第 6 条是**正向要求**（不是互斥）：batch-invariant 的前提是每个 prompt 的 prefill 在自己的网格上分块，而任何前缀命中都会跳过一段前缀、把边界挪走——所以规则 3 与 6 的「为什么」其实是同一个物理原因的两种表现。

**第四段：`--dflash-draft-model-path` 冲突表**（外层条件 `shared.dflash_draft_model_path.is_some()`，[L243-L259](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L243-L259)）：互斥 `--enable-lora`、`--kv-offload`，要求 `--tp-size=1`。注意 DFlash 是**共享 flag**（`SharedArgs.dflash_draft_model_path`，GLM5.2 也用它接 DSpark drafter，见 [../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:198-204](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L198-L204)），而 EAGLE-3 是 Qwen3 独占——同名物在两层体系里各有一个，这是个容易混淆的点。

**第五段：`--eagle3-draft-model-path` 冲突表**——写法换成了「谓词表 + find」（[L260-L284](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L260-L284)）：

```rust
let conflicts = [
    (shared.dflash_draft_model_path.is_some(), "--dflash-draft-model-path"),
    (cli.enable_lora, "--enable-lora"),
    (shared.kv_offload, "--kv-offload"),
    (shared.decode_overlap != CliDecodeOverlap::Off, "--decode-overlap"),
    (cli.batch_invariant, "--batch-invariant"),
];
if let Some((_, flag)) = conflicts.iter().find(|(set, _)| *set) {
    return Err(CliError::rule(format!(
        "--eagle3-draft-model-path is not supported with {flag}"
    )));
}
if shared.tp_size != 1 {
    return Err(CliError::rule(
        "--eagle3-draft-model-path currently requires --tp-size=1",
    ));
}
```

抄成二维表：

| # | 冲突对象（判定条件） | 错误消息 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `--dflash-draft-model-path` 已提供 | `--eagle3-draft-model-path is not supported with --dflash-draft-model-path` |
| 2 | `--enable-lora` | `... is not supported with --enable-lora` |
| 3 | `--kv-offload` | `... is not supported with --kv-offload` |
| 4 | `--decode-overlap` ≠ off | `... is not supported with --decode-overlap` |
| 5 | `--batch-invariant` | `... is not supported with --batch-invariant` |
| 6 | `--tp-size ≠ 1` | `--eagle3-draft-model-path currently requires --tp-size=1` |

两段风格对比是有意的教学素材：if 链每条可以有定制的长解释（batch-invariant 的第 2、3、6 条都带物理原因），表 + find 则把同构规则压成数据、按声明顺序取**第一个**命中——所以同时给 `--enable-lora --kv-offload` 时，报的是表里靠前的 `--enable-lora`。

另一个值得注意的不对称：字段文档说 EAGLE-3 「forces the prefix cache off」（引擎侧行为，launch 自己关），而 `--batch-invariant` 要求**用户亲手**传 `--no-prefix-cache`（校验期拒绝）。同样是与前缀缓存不相容，一个是引擎代劳、一个是硬性 CLI 前提。

最后是**纵深防御**：这些规则在引擎深处还会再被查一次。`crate::launch` 里对 TP + decode-overlap 的 `ensure!` 旁边有一条注释：「在 `enable_decode_overlap`（承重墙）也拒绝；在这里先失败，省下整次 TP 模型加载 + 图预捕获」（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs:310-315](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs#L310-L315)）。同一规则的三层：CLI `validate`（最便宜，连日志横幅都没打）→ `launch` 入口的 `ensure!`（在权重加载前）→ 引擎内部的承重守卫（不信任何调用方）。

### 4.3 launch：把两面 CLI 折成 Qwen3LaunchOptions

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

`launch` 是 trait 的最后一个方法，也是唯一必选的「重」方法：加载引擎、启动调度器线程、把句柄交还 server。但本讲聚焦它的**前半段**——选项组装：把 `SharedArgs`（15 个消费字段的值）与 `Qwen3Cli`（13 个独占字段）折叠成 crate 内部的单一结构 `Qwen3LaunchOptions`，再调用 `crate::launch`。

这个折叠有一句设计宣言，写在 `Qwen3LaunchOptions` 的文档注释里：二进制把原始 CLI flag 映射进这个结构；**启动策略（TP→设备映射、LoRA↔CUDA-Graph 互斥等）归 `launch` 所有，跟模型住在一起，不漏进 server**（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs:224-229](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs#L224-L229)）。也就是说：CLI 层的 `validate` 负责「用户可知的规则」，引擎层的 `crate::launch` 负责「实现可知的策略」——例如 LoRA 会强制关掉 CUDA Graph 并打一条 warn，这发生在 launch 内部而非 validate（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs:275-284](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs#L275-L284)）。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

`ModelLine::launch`（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:296-367](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L296-L367)）的折叠伪代码：

```text
launch(ctx):
    cli    = Qwen3Cli::from_arg_matches(ctx.matches)   # 取回独占值
    shared = ctx.shared                                  # 只读共享值

    # 1) offload：三段嵌套组装
    offload = if shared.kv_offload:
        bytes = kv_offload_host_gib 换算成字节
        o = Qwen3OffloadOptions::enabled(bytes)
        o.use_hugepages = kv_offload_hugepages
        if (metaserver_addr, advertise_addr) 都给了:
            o = o.with_p2p(地址 + nics + cli.kv_p2p_flush_on_finish)
        if cli.kv_pd_vllm_seed 给了:
            o = o.with_vllm_compat(seed + namespace.expect(...) + miss_wait)
        o
    else:
        Qwen3OffloadOptions::disabled()

    # 2) lora：enable_lora 才有内容
    lora = cli.enable_lora ? Qwen3LoraOptions{max_loras, max_lora_rank} : None

    # 3) 显存：MiB→字节防溢出，再就地校验取值
    margin_bytes = kv_cache_memory_margin_mib.checked_mul(1<<20) 否则 anyhow 报错
    memory = Qwen3MemoryOptions::new(util, margin_bytes, page).validate()?

    # 4) 一把折成 Qwen3LaunchOptions，调用 crate::launch
    crate::launch(ctx.model_path, Qwen3LaunchOptions{...})    # 返回 Engine
        .map(LaunchedEngine::Stepped)                          # 包成交接类型
```

`crate::launch` 内部再按策略分派：有 LoRA 走 `start_engine_with_lora_control`（铸造控制平面），否则走 `start_engine_with_offload_inner` 并带上 drafter 与图导出路径（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs:337-367](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs#L337-L367)）。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**offload 的三段嵌套**（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:299-327](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L299-L327)）：GiB→字节换算、开 `Qwen3OffloadOptions::enabled`、贴上 hugepages 开关；两个 P2P 地址**同时**给了才 `with_p2p`（这两个的同时性由 `SHARED_ARG_REQUIREMENTS` 的 `kv_p2p_metaserver_addr → {kv_offload, kv_p2p_advertise_addr, kv_p2p_nics}` 依赖边保证，见 [../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:223-232](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L223-L232)）；`kv_pd_vllm_seed` 给了才 `with_vllm_compat`。

其中这句最值得停下来看：

```rust
namespace: cli
    .kv_pd_vllm_namespace
    .clone()
    .expect("clap requires kv_pd_vllm_namespace"),
```

一个 `expect` 敢写在这里，是因为它的安全性由**两台前置机器**共同保证：`arg_requirements` 声明了 `kv_pd_vllm_seed → kv_pd_vllm_namespace` 的依赖边（clap 解析期执行），而 u2-l3 讲过注册表在**构造期**校验过这条边的目标 id 真实存在。缺任何一台，这行都是隐患；两台都在，它是把「跨模块不变量」压缩成一行的惯用法。

**lora 与显存预算**（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:328-340](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L328-L340)）：`enable_lora.then_some(...)` 把布尔翻成 `Option`；`checked_mul(1 << 20)` 防 MiB→字节换算溢出，溢出时返回 anyhow 错误（这是「深上下文、调用方不分支」错误哲学的又一次体现——u2-l1 讲过 launch 的错误用 anyhow 的原因）。

`Qwen3MemoryOptions::validate()` 只查两件事：`0 < gpu_memory_utilization <= 1`，且页大小在 `{16, 64}` 内（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs:65-78](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L65-L78)）。注意这两条**没有**对应的 clap 取值解析器——它们住在模型 crate 里，失败的时机在 launch 内部（`spawn_blocking` 线程上），错误链会带上外层 `.with_context(|| format!("failed to start {} engine", line.name()))` 的前缀（[src/main.rs:204-213](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L204-L213)）。同一段里 `max_prefill_tokens` 缺省时落到 crate 默认 `DEFAULT_MAX_PREFILL_TOKENS = 1024`（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/scheduler.rs:416](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/scheduler.rs#L416)）。

**枚举翻译**：CLI 侧的 `CliDecodeOverlap`（frontend，三档：`off`/`stream`/`green-ctx`）经 `resolve_decode_overlap` 翻成引擎侧的 `DecodeOverlap`，green-ctx 档顺带把共享 flag `decode_sm_pct` 塞进变体载荷（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:118-126](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L118-L126)；引擎枚举见 [../pegainfer-qwen3/src/green_ctx.rs:29-38](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/green_ctx.rs#L29-L38)）。两个同名枚举分居两侧，正是「接缝上只传值、不传类型」的体现。

**最后的交接**：`crate::launch(...).map(LaunchedEngine::Stepped)`（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:341-366](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L341-L366)）。Qwen3 已完成向新一代 step 驱动契约的迁移，返回 `Engine`（实现了 `Scheduler`）后包成 `LaunchedEngine::Stepped`——这就是 u1-l3 说过的「LoRA 分支要求 `Stepped`」能对 Qwen3 成立的原因。顺带一提 `serve_plan`（u2-l5 的主角，此处一笔带过）：Qwen3Line 只设 `lora_modules` 一个字段，其余全走 `ServePlan::default()`（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs:288-294](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/model_line.rs#L288-L294)）。

**`crate::launch` 持有的策略**（我们只看与 CLI 相关的几条）：TP→设备映射（单卡用 `device_ordinal`，多卡占 `0..tp_size`，[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs:270-274](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs#L270-L274)）；LoRA 强制关 CUDA Graph 并 warn（[L275-L284](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs#L275-L284)）；图导出的前置检查（[L285-L295](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs#L285-L295)）；DFlash 与 EAGLE-3 不能同载、drafter 不与 LoRA / decode-overlap 组合（[L316-L336](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/lib.rs#L316-L336)）。这些 `ensure!` 与 CLI `validate` 部分重叠——重叠不是浪费，是「CLI 层早失败省时间、引擎层承重保安全」的分层（见 4.2.3 末尾）。

#### 4.3.4 代码实践：launch 里的廉价检查仍在权重之前

1. **实践目标**：证明「住在 launch 里的取值检查」（显存预算）虽晚于 CLI validate，但仍早于任何权重/GPU 工作。
2. **操作步骤**（复用综合实践准备的 config-only 目录，见第 5 节；也可用本地真实检查点目录）：
   ```bash
   cargo run --release -- --model-path /tmp/qwen3-config-only --gpu-memory-utilization 1.5
   cargo run --release -- --model-path /tmp/qwen3-config-only --kv-page-size 32
   ```
3. **需要观察的现象**：两条命令都**已经打印** `Loading engine...` 横幅（说明已进入 `spawn_blocking` 里的 launch），随后失败；错误链形如 `failed to start Qwen3 engine: gpu_memory_utilization must be in (0, 1], got 1.5` 与 `... page_size must be one of [16, 64], got 32`。目录里没有任何权重分片也足以触发——证明失败点在 `Qwen3MemoryOptions::validate()`（[../pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs:65-78](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/../pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L65-L78)），先于 `crate::launch` 的任何加载动作。
4. **预期结果**：与 4.2 的 validate 失败对比——那次连横幅都没有。两处失败的分界线就是 `info!("Loading engine...")`（[src/main.rs:188-189](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L188-L189)）。本讲义写作环境无 GPU，**待本地验证**。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`launch` 里 `Qwen3MemoryOptions::new(...).validate()?` 的 `?` 发生在 `crate::launch(...)` 调用之前还是之后？这意味着什么？
**答案**：之前——它写在 `Qwen3LaunchOptions` 结构体字面量内部，而字面量先于 `crate::launch` 求值。意味着取值非法时连 `crate::launch` 都不会进入，CUDA、分词器、权重一概未被触碰，失败成本几乎为零。

**练习 2**：如果把 `kv_pd_vllm_namespace` 从 `arg_requirements` 的依赖边里删掉，4.3.3 里那句 `.expect("clap requires kv_pd_vllm_namespace")` 会变成什么？
**答案**：从一个「被两台机器保证的不变量」退化成真实的崩溃风险：用户只给 `--kv-pd-vllm-seed` 不给 namespace 时，clap 不再拦截，launch 将在 `spawn_blocking` 线程上 panic。这正是 u2-l3 讲的「依赖目标在注册表构造期被校验」的价值所在。

**练习 3**：为什么 `resolve_decode_overlap` 需要同时接收 `overlap` 与 `decode_sm_pct` 两个参数？
**答案**：`decode_sm_pct` 只在 green-ctx 档有意义（u2-l2 讲过它的共享规则），而 CLI 侧 `CliDecodeOverlap::GreenCtx` 变体本身不携带百分比；翻译成引擎侧 `DecodeOverlap::GreenCtx { decode_pct }` 时必须从共享 flag 里把值取来填进变体载荷。

## 6. 本讲小结

- **独占 CLI 面**：`Qwen3Cli` 五组十三个 flag（LoRA 4、KV P2P/PD 4、显存预算 3、batch-invariant 1、EAGLE-3 1），类型私有、拼写公开；三个取值解析器把格式错误挡在 clap 解析期——早于读取 `config.json`。
- **两份声明**：`consumed_shared_args`（15 个共享 id）划定消费面，`arg_requirements`（4 条边）把存在性依赖交给 clap；后者与注册表构造期校验一起，让 launch 里的 `.expect` 成为安全不变量。
- **冲突矩阵**：`validate` 以「provided 出身 + 两面 CLI 当前值」交叉判定，五段规则覆盖 LoRA 门槛、overlap 单卡限制、batch-invariant（6 条）、DFlash（3+1 条）、EAGLE-3（5+1 条）；两种写法（if 链 vs 谓词表 + find）各有取舍，消息即 API。
- **分层失败**：同一规则可出现在 CLI validate（最便宜）→ `crate::launch` 的 `ensure!`（权重加载前）→ 引擎承重守卫（最深）三层；可观察分界线是 `Loading engine...` 横幅。
- **launch 折叠**：`SharedArgs + Qwen3Cli → Qwen3LaunchOptions → crate::launch → LaunchedEngine::Stepped`；启动策略（TP 设备映射、LoRA 关图、drafter 互斥）归模型 crate 所有，不漏进 server。
- Qwen3 是 trait 的「八方法满配」参照实现（u2-l1 的结论在此落地），且其冲突矩阵中 batch-invariant 一支尚无专门单测——那是读者可贡献的第一块砖。

tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.
